dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: The flowers bloom and fade, people come and go, but the Lantern Rite will be held each year right on time.

dialogues.speaker: Madame Ping
dialogues.text: But this year's Rite is quite different from those of yesteryear. Go, go have a look around. Enjoy the sights and sounds of Liyue Harbor.
